prompt.description: The edit or composition to make. Refer to references as image 1, image 2 … in order; a mask or annotated copy is just another reference.

images.description: Reference images in order (1-10): the image to edit, extra subjects, a mask or a copy with circles or painted notes. Each is resized to about one megapixel; transparency is kept.

width.description: Output width in pixels; omitted, the last reference's aspect ratio at about one megapixel.

height.description: Output height in pixels; omitted, the last reference's aspect ratio at about one megapixel.
